# Markdown links

Obsidian caches `[text](path.md)` the same way it caches a wikilink.

A relative markdown link: [the note](note.md).

An absolute URL is not a reference: [example](https://example.com/y.md).

Nor is an Obsidian URI: [open](obsidian://open?file=note.md).

A percent-encoded space: [spaced](sp%20ace.md).

An angle-bracketed path holding a real space: [angled](<sp ace.md>).

The doubled extension, as a markdown link: [doubled](note.md.md).

The same file, as a wikilink: [[note.md.md]].

A markdown image: ![diagram](assets/diagram.png).

A markdown link to a PDF: [spec](assets/doc.pdf).
